atomic_item_binding_contract: atomic source_artifact_identity MUST equal exactly one manifest entry artifact_identity
atomic source_artifact_sha256_or_pinned_identity MUST equal that entry pinned_identity
atomic source_provenance_identity MUST equal that entry provenance_identity
atomic source_fact_type MUST equal that entry source_fact_type
atomic source_side MUST equal that entry source_side
RAW-side atomic raw_key MUST equal manifest bound_raw_key
CANDIDATE-side atomic candidate_scoring_id MUST equal manifest bound_candidate_scoring_id
atomic exact_field_path_or_claim_id MUST be the exact RFC6901 JSON Pointer of the emitted leaf
atomic authenticated_value_canonical_json MUST be the exact parsed scalar JSON value at that pointer

deny_rule.artifact_class_gate: source_artifact_class MUST be exactly one of the four allowed V4 source_artifact_classes; all other artifact/output classes are rejected
deny_rule.comparative_or_historical_content: no derived/comparative/historical class is generated; any authenticated artifact already classified outside the four allowed source classes is rejected as a whole
deny_rule.exact_field_name_gate: before traversing an object member, decode/use its exact source key; if that exact key equals any V4 denylist exact_field_names member, reject that member's entire subtree

mapping_rule: EXACT_ONE_TO_ONE_BY_SOURCE_ARTIFACT_CLASS; no fallback and no model choice

cross_constraints: source_fact_type MUST equal the unique class_to_type_mapping value for source_artifact_class
RAW side requires non-null bound_raw_key and null bound_candidate_scoring_id
CANDIDATE side requires non-null bound_candidate_scoring_id and null bound_raw_key
artifact_identity MUST be unique within a source_artifact_manifest
provenance_identity MUST independently recompute from the exact manifest entry

field_constraints.bound_candidate_scoring_id: exact current candidate_scoring_id when source_side=CANDIDATE; JSON null otherwise
field_constraints.bound_raw_key: exact current raw_key when source_side=RAW; JSON null otherwise

structured_source_rule.root_scalar: PROHIBITED; source artifact must provide an object or array root
structured_source_rule.string_handling: ENTIRE_EXACT_STRING_VALUE_IS_ONE_FIELD_VALUE; no sentence split, token split, summary, paraphrase, claim extraction, or semantic normalization
structured_source_rule.value_hash_rule: authenticated_value_sha256 = sha256(canonical_json(exact parsed scalar JSON value))

text_claim_rule: TEXT_CLAIM_FACT_TYPES_PROHIBITED_FOR_CURRENT86_R2; no claim segmentation and no generated/pre-existing claim-ID extraction is used
